summary.text:
Public entry point for @pixel-brewery/synapse-auth.

Isolated account profiles, native authentication and backend-managed API-key connections.
Authenticates backend-owned API-key connections without a CLI or inference driver.

content.text:
Use through AuthManager so credential changes share its profile gate, expiry and
correlated input lifecycle. The host injects authorized secret storage and a bounded provider
verifier. Construction and method discovery perform no I/O. Keys never enter instance options,
public status, progress or error causes. No provider SDK, HTTP client or model call is included.

Invalid input, rejected verification and cancellation before storage leave the
previous key intact. AuthManager performs a final status check after this method completes.
Input is trimmed at its edges, limited to 65,536 characters and rejects remaining whitespace
or ASCII control characters. The credentials interaction expires after five minutes, further
bounded by AuthManager's operation expiry. Store implementations must honor cancellation at
their atomic commit boundary.

content.text:
The host supplies durable encrypted storage and authorization. No default storage,
encryption key, filesystem path or cloud service is selected by Synapse. Implementations must
scope every operation by the complete identity tuple, honor cancellation before mutation,
atomically replace a key, and preserve the previous key when replacement fails before commit.
The profile coordinator serializes one process; hosts coordinate concurrent backend replicas
through their storage/connection owner. Returned keys are backend-only secrets.

content.text:
A stored string or a matching key prefix is not verified authentication. Implementations
must perform a bounded, non-inference authentication check, honor cancellation and return only
safe account metadata. Provider endpoints, HTTP policy, SDK dependencies and authorization
remain with the injected adapter. Verification does not prove access to every model or budget.
No model invocation, streaming implementation or provider SDK is supplied by this contract.

content.text:
Reuse one manager for all profiles in a host. Version 1 ownership markers reserve
every canonical profile directory across manager instances, including explicit legacy mappings.
Ancestor and descendant checks reject foreign overlapping claims. Each of the two inspection
passes visits at most 4,096 directories, 32,768 entries and 64 nested levels without following
directory symlinks; mappings that cannot be verified within those limits fail closed.
Claims already written before an initialization failure remain reserved; the same identity
and mapping can reopen them. Existing native files are never copied or removed.
Reopening a legacy version 1 profile backfills missing sidecars. Previously unmarked external
directories have no discoverable persistent owner until they are explicitly claimed.
POSIX directories/files use 0700/0600; Windows hosts supply a private ACL-protected base.
